sources.title: Burkina Faso travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: Norway's Foreign Ministry publishes this live Norwegian-citizen entry page on regjeringen.no; it was updated 9 January 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Det er visumplikt for norske borgere og visum må innhentes på forhånd.

sources.title: Central African Republic travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The live regjeringen.no Foreign Ministry country page expressly directs Norwegian visitors to the Central African Republic Embassy in Paris for visas; its entry text was last revised in 2024.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ta kontakt med Den sentralafrikanske republikks ambassade i Paris for visum.

sources.title: Comoros travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Norwegian Foreign Ministry page expressly describes purchase of the ordinary Norwegian visitor visa at arrival; the page was last updated 31 May 2024.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visum kan kjøpes ved ankomst til 30 euro.

sources.title: Liberia travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Norwegian Foreign Ministry country page, updated 26 June 2026, expressly names Norway in the Liberia visa-on-arrival cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Borgere fra land hvor Liberia ikke har ambassade – inkludert Norge – kan søke om visum ved ankomst.

sources.title: Liberia Visa on Arrival application portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The live portal identifies the Liberia Immigration Service as the authority and describes approval, airport biometrics and visa-sticker issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once completed, you will receive a visa sticker in your passport.

sources.title: Mali travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Norwegian Foreign Ministry page was updated 15 January 2026 and separates electronic entry authorization from issuance of the visa at Bamako arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visumet utstedes ved ankomst i Bamako.

sources.title: South Sudan travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Norwegian Foreign Ministry page, updated 29 May 2026, identifies Norwegian citizens and links their visa application to South Sudan's official service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Norske borgere trenger visum for opphold i Sør-Sudan. Søknadsprosessen foregår på nett.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: South Sudan Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live .gov.ss portal identifies the Ministry of Interior and its immigration e-visa department, and directs approved applicants to download the visa PDF before travel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Download your e-visa PDF from anywhere within 72 hours.

sources.title: Syria travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Norwegian Foreign Ministry page, updated 28 February 2026, tells Norwegians to apply to Syria's Embassy in Sweden for a visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nordmenn som må reise til Syria bes kontakte Syrias ambassade i Sverige, se kontaktdetaljer nedenfor, for å søke om visum.

sources.title: Afghanistan travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Norwegian Foreign Ministry country page says its Afghanistan entry information may change at short notice and describes only some Afghan embassies as still issuing visas; it does not establish a stable ordinary Norwegian visitor route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Noen afghanske ambassader utsteder fremdeles visum, men dette kan endre seg på kort varsel.

sources.title: Chad travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Norwegian Foreign Ministry page was updated 10 August 2026 and says Norwegians need a Chad visa, but its embassy contact does not identify the ordinary visitor issuance channel or timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nordmenn trenger visum for å besøke Tsjad.

sources.title: Republic of the Congo travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Norwegian Foreign Ministry page still says a visa is required, but its entry content was last updated in June 2024 and gives no ordinary Norwegian visitor issuance channel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Gyldig pass, visum og bevis for gulfeber-vaksine er påkrevet for innreise til landet.

sources.title: North Korea travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Norwegian Foreign Ministry page was updated 15 May 2026 and makes tourism conditional on a pre-approved tour operator, while directing visa enquiries to DPRK's Stockholm embassy; it does not prove a normalized visitor issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For å reise til Nord-Korea som turist må man være med på et fastlagt opplegg i regi av forhåndsgodkjente turoperatører.

sources.title: Palestine travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Norwegian Foreign Ministry page was updated 30 June 2026 and says Israel controls all Palestinian entry and exit. It records crossing-, identity-record- and permit-dependent outcomes rather than a Palestine-wide Norwegian visitor status.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All innreise og utreise til Palestina, inkludert sjø- og luftvei, kontrolleres av Israel.

sources.title: Sudan travel information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Norwegian Foreign Ministry page was updated 17 June 2026 and confirms a visa requirement, while directing travellers to Sudan's embassy and warning that entry rules may change at short notice; it does not establish issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Det er visumplikt til Sudan. Vi viser til Sudans ambassade i Oslo for nærmere informasjon.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports receive a Comoros visa on arrival
policies.summary: Norway's Foreign Ministry says Norwegian visitors can purchase the visa at arrival.
conditions: Ordinary machine-readable Norwegian passport valid at least six months from arrival.
Return ticket required; visa purchased at arrival.
The live source was last updated 31 May 2024; recheck this pair earlier than the standard refresh interval.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports use Liberia's visa-on-arrival route
policies.summary: Norway specifically appears in the current Liberian no-embassy visa-on-arrival cohort; the visa sticker is issued at the airport after approval and biometrics.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport and short visitor travel.
Apply online before travel and present the approved confirmation at Roberts International Airport for biometric collection and visa-sticker issuance.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports receive the Mali visa on arrival after electronic authorization
policies.summary: Norway's current guidance says the entry authorization is electronic but the visa itself is issued at Bamako on arrival.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport and short visitor travel.
Apply and pay online first; carry the electronic entry authorization for visa issuance at Bamako arrival.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports receive a South Sudan eVisa
policies.summary: Norway directs Norwegian applicants to South Sudan's online visa service, which provides the approved eVisa PDF before travel.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport and short visitor travel.
Apply online and download the approved eVisa PDF before travel; present it at entry.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports require a Syrian consular visa
policies.summary: Norway's current guidance directs Norwegian visitors to apply for a Syrian visa through the Embassy in Sweden.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport and short visitor travel.
Apply through the Syrian Embassy in Sweden before travel; requirements may change at short notice.

conflicts.explanation: Norway is expressly in Liberia's no-embassy visa-on-arrival cohort, with the sticker issued at the airport after online approval and biometrics.
The electronic entry authorization precedes travel, but Norway says the visa is issued at Bamako on arrival.
Current Norwegian guidance directs Norwegians to apply for the visa through Syria's Embassy in Sweden rather than an eVisa route.

unresolved.reason: The live Norwegian guidance says only that some Afghan embassies still issue visas and that this can change at short notice. It does not establish a stable ordinary Norwegian short-visitor eligibility or issuance route; operational restrictions are not taxonomy states.

No accessible current official BVI source directly maps an ordinary Norwegian short visitor to a visa classification or issuance result. Territory treatment and any third-country-document waiver are not inferred into an ordinary Norwegian visitor exemption.
Current Norwegian guidance says the visa must be obtained before travel and refers applicants to an embassy for information, but does not establish whether issuance is consular or electronic.
The entry text was last revised in March 2024 and retains obsolete health requirements; its embassy reference is not treated as verified 2026 issuance evidence.

Current Norwegian guidance confirms that Norwegians need a Chad visa and directs enquiries to the embassy, but it does not establish whether the ordinary visitor visa is issued electronically, at the border or at a mission.

The live Norwegian page says a visa is required for the Republic of the Congo but its entry content is last updated in 2024 and does not establish an ordinary Norwegian visitor issuance channel or timing.

Current Norwegian guidance makes tourism conditional on a pre-approved operator arrangement and directs visa enquiries to DPRK's Stockholm embassy. It does not establish ordinary Norwegian visitor issuance or operational availability, so no status is normalized.

Current Norwegian guidance says Israel controls all Palestinian entry and exit and records crossing-, permit- and identity-record-dependent outcomes. Israeli crossing documentation does not establish a Palestine-wide Norwegian visitor status.

Current Norwegian guidance confirms that Sudan requires a visa but directs travellers to the embassy and warns that rules may change at short notice. It does not establish whether the ordinary Norwegian visitor visa is electronic, border-issued or mission-issued.
